tecnologias.title: My Skills
tecnologias.landing_pages_description: Creation of landing pages with a modern and responsive design, forms for sending emails, to boost your bussiness in internet.
tecnologias.api_description: Integration with external APIs to extend the functionality of applications and creation of APIs following business rules.
tecnologias.fullstack_description: Complete systems development, from the front-end to the back-end with or without a database, microsservices architecture, automated tests, encryption and the latest security techniques.
tecnologias.mobile_description: Developing modern, fast, and intuitive applications for Android and iOS using Flutter. I create apps with fluid interfaces, native features, and high performance, ensuring a quality mobile experience.
tecnologias.tests_description: Development of unit and integration tests using Vitest and Cypress, and for backend using JUnit, Mockito, Jest, and Docker.
tecnologias.deployment_description: Deployment both frontend and backend with or without a database using tools such as GitHub, Docker, Vercel and AWS.

classscheduling.title: Class Scheduling
classscheduling.subtitle: Scheduling system for a school.
classscheduling.description: Created from absolute scratch, this site allows logged-in users to create and manage their appointments. The system includes a REST API, Swagger documentation, database integration, encryption, unit and integration tests, and email sending functionality.

praiacheia.title: Praia Cheia
praiacheia.subtitle: An app to show the number of people on the beaches
praiacheia.description: This landing page, as well as the Praia Cheia app, were created by me after being hired to execute the brilliant idea of ​​creating an app that would provide information on the best route, weather forecast, and beach occupancy levels in Rio de Janeiro.

gamerexplorer.title: GamerExplorer
gamerexplorer.subtitle: System of exibition of games
gamerexplorer.description: A system developed with Angular that uses the RAWG API to display and search for games, allowing users to save their favorite games and watch trailers on YouTube.

barbabrutal.title: Barbabrutal
barbabrutal.subtitle: Barbershop appointments made easy.
barbabrutal.description: A barbershop scheduling system that allows the user to make and manage their appointments after logging in, this system has REST API, database and encryption

gamerstore.title: GamerStore
gamerstore.subtitle: E-commerce with microsservice archtecture
gamerstore.description: This site is a true e-commerce with event-oriented microservice architecture, with integration with Stripe API for payment, cart, sign up of users, address and and credit card and show orders and products and IA for suggestion products.

weather.title: Weather Project
weather.subtitle: Current weather conditions in any city worldwide.
weather.description: This project consumes the Open Weather API to display current weather conditions. The site automatically changes to Snow Mode, Cloud Mode, or Summer Mode based on the searched city's temperature.

movies.title: Buscador de Filmes
movies.subtitle: Discover movies in theaters and save your favorites.
movies.description: This project uses TheMovieDB API to list trending movies and allows users to search the catalog. Features include saving to favorites and watching trailers on YouTube.
